title: Exact replicate of 001 with harness --seed 1 (noise measurement, not an idea)
description: No change to pretrain.py. The harness seed changes init, data order, the 1500-target subsample and the sampling RNG. Kept/discarded runs with near-identical pretrain stats have scored 7, 30, 56, 67, so the keep rule needs a same-config replicate to calibrate against.
hypothesis: If this lands anywhere in 7-67 the loop's single-run keep rule is not informative at this budget and the fix is on the harness side (more eval attempts, more targets, or the metric itself), not in pretrain.py.
surprise: Same pretrain.py, seed 1: metric 14 vs 67 (seed 0). Best pretrain stats of any run (greedy 0.947, r1 solved 85) and the second-worst metric. The single-run keep rule cannot distinguish anything at this budget.
